params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page of the collection to return.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Items per page. Maximum 100 — a request for 101 is rejected with 400 `rest_invalid_param` (verified 2026-08-05).

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit to items published after a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit to items published before a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit to items modified after a given ISO 8601 date — the incremental-sync cursor.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to one or more slugs.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated sparse-fieldset projection, e.g. `_fields=id,slug,title`. Applies to every collection and item operation.

params.name: _embed
params.description: Inline the linked resources (author, featured media, terms) into `_embedded` instead of requiring follow-up requests.

params.name: categories
params.description: Limit to posts assigned the given category term IDs.

params.name: tags
params.description: Limit to posts assigned the given tag term IDs.
